meta.title: 尴尬笑→氛围笑✨三步笑出活人感📚来上网课！
meta.title_en: Awkward Smile to Vibey Smile: 3 Steps to a 'Real Human' Smile

scenes.title_cn: 开场：想拍出这种超有感染力的妈生感笑…
scenes.context: 专为普通人设计的大笑作弊法。
sentences: 想拍出这种超有感染力的妈生感笑容，对于普通人来说简直太难了。
That deeply infectious natural smile is so hard for ordinary people.
natural smile（妈生感笑容）
直接把我课上专门针对普通人学拍照而设计的大笑作弊法拿出来给你学。
I'll hand you the big-smile cheat code made for everyday people.
cheat code（作弊法）
我教一步，你学一步，上课！
I teach one step, you learn one step. Class is in session!
class time（上课）
scenes.speak: That deeply infectious natural smile is so hard for ordinary people. I'll hand you the big-smile cheat code made for everyday people. I teach one step, you learn one step. Class is in session!

scenes.title_cn: 第一招：奸笑不好看，那就干脆挡起来。…
scenes.title_en: Move one: if your smile is ugly, just cove…
scenes.context: 食指挡鼻弱化嘴，下眼睑收缩显笑意。
sentences: 把食指轻轻地盖住你的鼻头处，让指尖稍稍超过鼻头大概两到三公分。
Lay the finger over the nose tip, passing it by two to three centimeters.
cover the nose（挡鼻头）
弱化了嘴巴的存在，视觉中心就会转移到眼睛上。
Weaken the mouth, and the visual center shifts to the eyes.
shift the focus（转移视觉）
这时就需要借助我们下眼睑的收缩力。
Now engage the lower eyelid contraction.
eyelid squeeze（下眼睑收缩）
眼睛一弯，浓浓的笑意就从眼睛里透出来了。
The eyes curve and a rich smile shines out of them.
curved eyes（眼睛一弯）
scenes.speak: Lay the finger over the nose tip, passing it by two to three centimeters. Weaken the mouth, and the visual center shifts to the eyes. Now engage the lower eyelid contraction. The eyes curve and a rich smile shines out of them.

scenes.title_cn: 补充：如果你实在学不来下眼睑用力，你…
scenes.title_en: Bonus: if you really can't learn the lower…
scenes.context: 闭眼皱鼻也能制造感染力。
sentences: 如果你实在学不来下眼睑用力，可以试试把眼睛闭起来，再用力去皱鼻子。
If the eyelid squeeze is hard, close your eyes and scrunch your nose.
scrunch the nose（皱鼻子）
虽然五官会被挤成一团，但这份感染力绝对无敌了。
The features bunch up, but the appeal is unbeatable.
unbeatable appeal（无敌感染力）
scenes.speak: If the eyelid squeeze is hard, close your eyes and scrunch your nose. The features bunch up, but the appeal is unbeatable.

scenes.title_cn: 第二招：假如氛围不够，就用头发来凑。…
scenes.title_en: Move two: if the vibe isn't enough, let yo…
scenes.context: 身体倾斜+头发悬空传递快乐。
sentences: 一个人在极度开心的时候，常常会笑得前仰后合，头发也会跟着甩来甩去。
In extreme joy, people rock back and forth and hair flies around.
joyful motion（快乐动作）
身体呈现出一种倾斜状态，并且头发是悬空的，就会传递给镜头一种强烈的快乐情绪。
A leaning body with floating hair radiates strong joy to the lens.
lean and float（倾斜悬空）
头发偶尔会被拍得有些凌乱，但这恰恰又是活人感的关键。
Messy hair is exactly the key to the real-human feel.
real-human feel（活人感）
scenes.speak: In extreme joy, people rock back and forth and hair flies around. A leaning body with floating hair radiates strong joy to the lens. Messy hair is exactly the key to the real-human feel.

scenes.title_cn: 第三招：如果笑不自然，那就让笑自然发…
scenes.title_en: Move three: if the smile won't come natura…
scenes.context: 制造尴尬让真笑自然发生。
sentences: 故意做点让自己尴尬到不行甚至有些沙雕的行为，我敢打赌没人能坚持到30秒。
Do something mortifying—I bet nobody lasts 30 seconds.
break the tension（绷不住）
你可以自己跟自己聊天，嘴巴里去念叨一些搞笑的台词。
Chat with yourself and mutter funny lines.
mutter lines（念叨台词）
反正挡着嘴巴啥也看不到，就尽管放任自己发疯好了。
The mouth's covered anyway—just let yourself go crazy.
let yourself go（放任自己）
scenes.speak: Do something mortifying—I bet nobody lasts 30 seconds. Chat with yourself and mutter funny lines. The mouth's covered anyway—just let yourself go crazy.

practice: Cover the nose tip with the index finger.
Squeeze the lower eyelid like doing aegyo-sal.
Close eyes and scrunch the nose instead.
Lean the body and let the hair float.
Do something silly to trigger a real laugh.
pitfalls: Smile with a stiff, empty look.
Weaken the mouth and engage the eyes.
Keep the fingertip just two to three centimeters past the nose.
Open the eyes wide and round.
Squeeze the lower eyelid into a curve.
瞪圆眼反而感染力全无。
Stand straight with hair stuck to the body.
Lean and let the hair float for a joyful feel.
直挺头发贴身难有氛围。
Force a perfect smile on demand.
Trigger a genuine laugh with silly actions.
shifts: 用 natural smile（妈生感笑容）、big-smile cheat code（大笑作弊法）、live-in smile（活人感）
用 lower eyelid contraction（下眼睑收缩）、aegyo-sal squeeze（卧蚕挤压）、crescent eyes（弯弯眼睛）
用 infectious（有感染力）、vibe（氛围感）、letting go（放任自己）
